SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_AT_RECORD T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.TARGETID, MAX(T.CREATEDTIME) AS CREATEDTIME, MIN(A.${nameField}) AS TARGETNAME FROM T_CORE_AT_RECORD T LEFT JOIN ${tableName} A ON T.TARGETID = CONCAT(#{tableName}, CONCAT('$', CAST(A.ID AS VARCHAR))) WHERE
T.TARGETID = CONCAT(#{tableName}, CONCAT('$', #{targetId}))
T.TARGETID LIKE CONCAT(#{tableName}, '$%')
AND T.CREATEDBYORGID = #{ownedAuditOrgId} GROUP BY T.TARGETID ORDER BY CREATEDTIME DESC
